subject: general
question: 1 Petabyte = ______
solution:
The correct answer is __**1024 TB.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **250 bytes** is occasionally used to define a** petabyte.**
 
• The **Base10 SI system** (SI) and the **Base2 IEC (IEC) systems** are two alternative systems for **measuring bytes.**
 
• While **250 bytes **is similar to** 1015,** it is larger and is referred to as a **pebibyte (PiB).**
 
• A petabyte is made up of **1,024 terabytes (TB)** or roughly **1 million gigabytes (GB).**
 
• **One exabyte** is made up of 1,024 petabytes.
 
• **Traditional data backups** are not suitable for a petabyte.
 
• A petabyte is thought to be the equivalent of **20 million tall filing cabinets** or **500 billion pages **of conventional written text, according to some estimations.
